base: Same candidate version as a5-rc2-pfs1-observation-v2. Only the run scope is extended from 4202 to the pre-registered 4302 single seed; physics, control, sampling, evaluator and observation code are byte-identical to v2.

extension.reason: 4202 single passed quality and evidence gates after the observation-only revision; a pre-registered cross-seed check on 4302 is the next single-run gate. This is not a new physical intervention.

changed_file_roles.a5-rc2-pfs1-observation-v2.json: registration/scope only; not read by simulation code
changed_file_roles.run-a5-rc2-pfs1-observation-v2.sh: orchestration only; scope, lock, ledger and pre/post checks

physical_invariance.action_targets: expert logic unchanged; targets are computed from the 4302 recovered state exactly as in RC2/pfs1/v2

observation_revision.only_change: inherited unchanged from v2: observation semantics, material readback and reporting; no physics/control change

velocity_policy.time_source: world.current_time at each passive post-step snapshot
velocity_policy.raw_api_usage: retained only as unvalidated data; not used for physical conclusions
velocity_policy.single_frame_stage_velocity: not computed; raw readback retained with invalid flag

fields: particle material prim path and attrs
particle group and raw filter attrs
material_readback.mismatch_action: stop before release and retain the partial evidence

semantic_validity.file_completeness: required result/evidence/stage files exist and their hashes match
observation_semantics: release-step records contain valid finite-difference velocities
raw velocity readback is marked unvalidated and is not required to be physically correct
material readback stages are present and match registered values
semantic_validity.quality_acceptance: evaluator quality accepted/rejected is recorded separately
semantic_validity.overall_pass: file completeness AND observation semantics AND quality accepted

contact_capability.reason: existing ContactRecorder/report channel does not expose cloth-particle contacts (D2-B)

comparison.against: RC2 4302 single (day4-a5-rc2-recovery-20261104-025702-598075) and, secondarily, v2/pfs1 4202 single
comparison.primary_purpose: cross-seed extension of the fixed particleFrictionScale candidate under valid observation semantics

notes: Extension of the fixed a5-rc2-pfs1-observation-v2 candidate; physics/control/observation sources are byte-identical to v2 (61/63 manifest entries unchanged).
Only a5-rc2-pfs1-observation-v2.json (registration) and run-a5-rc2-pfs1-observation-v2.sh (orchestration) differ from v2.
One 4302 single only, under a new manifest and a new one-shot lock; the v2 4202 result and completed marker are preserved.
No 4202 rerun, no seven-case RC, no freeze, no held-out, no formal batch, no parameter scan in this round.
Cloth-ground force/impulse remains unavailable and is not a new acceptance gate; material solver-effective value remains unverified.
